categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Hongjing Optoelectronic Technology Inc. primarily engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of optical lenses and camera modules. Its main business segments include smart automotive optical lenses and camera modules, emerging consumer optical lenses and camera modules, and other related products. The company focuses on three major product areas: smart automotive, smart home, and panoramic/sports cameras, with additional emerging business fields such as AI hardware, robotics vision, industrial inspection, and medical applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced optical design, precision manufacturing, and integrated imaging solutions combining optics, mechanics, electronics, and algorithms. Key technologies include automatic heating camera module design, ultra-high-definition camera modules, fatigue driving monitoring optical systems, wide-angle day-night confocal optical systems, and panoramic dual-camera optical systems. Manufacturing capabilities include vacuum coating, plastic and glass aspheric lens molding, lens automatic assembly, and active alignment (AA) focusing technology. The company also utilizes digital production systems such as PLM and MES for quality control and traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hongjing Optoelectronic serves major automotive manufacturers including Daimler-Benz, Nissan, Honda, Chery, BYD, Geely, Great Wall, Aion, NIO, and XPeng, as well as Tier 1 suppliers like Bosch, Aptiv, and Panasonic. In the smart home sector, it supplies high-end brands such as Ring, Blink, and Anker in Europe and the US. For panoramic and sports cameras, it collaborates closely with YingShi Innovation, a global leader in professional panoramic cameras. The company targets end markets including intelligent automotive systems, smart home devices, panoramic/sports cameras, AI hardware, robotics, industrial inspection, and medical imaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Zhongshan and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Xiangtao, Hubei Province. It serves both domestic and international markets, with approximately 73% of revenue from domestic sales and 27% from overseas markets. Its international customers are mainly in Europe and North America, especially in the smart home and automotive sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hongjing Optoelectronic operates in the midstream segment of the optical industry supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of optical lenses and camera modules. It procures upstream raw materials such as optical glass, resin, prisms, filters, and electronic components like CMOS image sensors and connectors. The company then designs and assembles these components into finished optical products for downstream application in consumer electronics, automotive electronics, security surveillance, and machine vision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven development with continuous investment in R&D, focusing on high-pixel, wide-angle, and lightweight optical systems. Key R&D projects include large-aperture, high-pixel smart home lenses, lightweight 48MP+ sports and panoramic camera lenses and modules, and high-pixel intelligent driving application lenses with enhanced temperature stability. It also develops consumer machine vision modules, AI eyewear camera modules, and industrial robot vision modules. The company maintains strong collaborations with chip and image processing manufacturers and academic institutions to accelerate innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Hongjing Optoelectronic generates revenue primarily through direct sales of optical lenses and camera modules to domestic and international customers. The company follows a 'make-to-order' production model, with sales conducted mainly through direct sales channels supplemented by distributors. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and transfer of control of goods to customers, with contracts typically specifying payment terms and quality guarantees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong competitive position in the global optical lens and camera module market, ranking seventh globally in automotive optical lenses with a 3.7% market share. It is a significant supplier in the smart home camera market with over 10% global share and a leading supplier in the professional panoramic camera market through its partnership with YingShi Innovation, which holds over 60% market share. Competitors include other Tier 1 automotive suppliers and optical component manufacturers in China and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hongjing Optoelectronic achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, representing a 41.24% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 165.23 million, up 41.91% from the previous year. The company’s net asset value reached RMB 590 million, growing 39.21% year-over-year. The company has maintained a strong growth trajectory driven by expanding market demand in smart automotive and consumer electronics sectors, supported by increased R&D investment and digital transformation initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced optical design and manufacturing technologies, delivering high-resolution, wide-angle, and temperature-stable optical lenses and camera modules. Its products feature innovations such as automatic heating functions for automotive cameras, glass-plastic hybrid lens technology for smart home devices, and ultra-high-definition panoramic camera modules. Strict quality control systems and certifications (ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949) ensure product reliability. The company’s close collaboration with leading global brands and Tier 1 suppliers enhances its market credibility and ability to meet diverse customer requirements.
